title: Hearty Syrian Borlotti Bean Tagine
description: A winey and flaky Syrian dish featuring borlotti beans, cooked in a tagine and suitable for kids, this vegetarian friendly meal is perfect for a family dinner.
instructions: Soak the borlotti beans in water for at least 8 hours, then drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the tagine and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the tagine and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste to the tagine and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the red wine, vegetable broth, soaked borlotti beans, salt, and black pepper to the tagine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
